summary: This immaculate and recently refurbished first-floor apartment is superbly positioned in the very heart of Eastbourne, offering the perfect blend of convenience and comfortable modern living. Located just a short stroll from the mainline train station, town centre and everyday amenities
description:
The property is ideally suited to commuters, first-time buyers, downsizers, and investors alike. The apartment presents an excellent investment opportunity, with a potential rental income of £650-£700 per calendar month. Externally, the development benefits from well-maintained communal gardens, creating a pleasant setting, along with the added advantage of an allocated parking space. Accessed via a secure and well-kept communal entrance, the apartment opens into a welcoming private hallway complete with a useful built-in storage cupboard, ideal for coats and household items. The accommodation is well laid out and thoughtfully designed throughout. There are two well-proportioned bedrooms, with the principal bedroom being a particular highlight, featuring a walk-in dressing area that provides generous storage and a touch of luxury. The open-plan lounge/kitchen serves as the heart of the home, offering a bright and sociable space for both relaxing and entertaining. French doors allow natural light to flood the room and open onto a charming Juliet balcony, creating an airy feel and bringing the outside in. The modern family bathroom is finished in a contemporary style and complements the overall move-in-ready condition of the apartment. Presented in excellent order throughout, this home is truly ready for immediate occupation, allowing a buyer to settle in with minimal effort. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality, space, and prime location on offer. Viewings are available immediately.

ENTRANCE HALL On entering the apartment, you are greeted by a welcoming hallway, complete with an intercom entry system for added security and convenience. A built-in storage cupboard provides practical space for coats, shoes, and household essentials. The hallway offers easy access to all principal rooms, creating a functional and well-planned flow throughout the apartment.

OPEN PLAN LOUNGE / KITCHEN The open-plan lounge and kitchen provides a generous and comfortable living space, perfect for relaxing, entertaining, and modern day living. The lounge area is flooded with natural light through UPVC double-glazed French doors opening onto a Juliet balcony, complemented by an additional UPVC-framed double-glazed window. Two radiators ensure the space remains warm and inviting throughout the year. The kitchen is thoughtfully designed with a range of fitted base and wall units, laminate work surfaces, and contrasting splashbacks that combine style with practicality. An inset sink with drainer and mixer tap sits neatly beneath a UPVC-framed double-glazed window. Integrated appliances include an oven, hob, and overhead extractor, while plumbing is provided for an automatic washing machine and space allocated for a fridge/freezer. Additional features include a wall-mounted gas central heating combination boiler and inset ceiling spotlights, creating a sleek and modern finish. This open-plan space truly serves as the heart of the apartment, offering a seamless blend of style, light, and functionality.

BEDROOM ONE The master bedroom is a spacious and inviting retreat, featuring a UPVC-framed double-glazed window that fills the room with natural light. A central radiator ensures the space remains warm and comfortable, while a door leads seamlessly into a generous walk-in dressing room, offering excellent storage and a practical yet stylish addition to the suite.

BEDROOM TWO The second bedroom is a bright and versatile space, featuring a UPVC-framed double-glazed window that allows plenty of natural light to fill the room. A central radiator ensures a comfortable temperature year-round, making this room ideal as a guest bedroom, home office, or additional living space.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom is fitted with a contemporary white suite, designed for both style and functionality. It comprises a panelled bath with a mains-fed rain head shower overhead, complemented by an additional rain head-style attachment for a luxurious showering experience. A wash hand basin and WC complete the suite, with tiling to splashback and vanity areas adding a sleek, modern finish. The room is further enhanced by a radiator and wall-mounted towel rail, providing warmth and convenience.

EXTERNALLY The property benefits from an allocated car parking space, offering convenient off-street parking. Residents also enjoy access to well-maintained communal gardens, providing a pleasant and tranquil outdoor space to relax and enjoy.
